title: Prescriptions Class Schedule: Refill Threshold, Booking Horizon and Ready Days
content:
Three per-class figures of Kestrel Prescriptions govern timing: the percent of the previous fill's days supply that must have elapsed before the next routine fill, how far ahead a patient may book a pickup date, and how many days a fill takes to be ready after booking.

| Handling class | Early refill threshold (percent of previous days supply elapsed) | Furthest pickup date that may be booked (calendar days after today) | Ready days after booking (0 means same day) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | 80 | 7 | 0 |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | 80 | 14 | 0 |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | 80 | 14 | 0 |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | 90 | 7 | 0 |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | 90 | 7 | 0 |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | 80 | 7 | 2 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Early refill threshold** — an integer percent: that share of the previous fill's days supply must have elapsed before the next routine fill.
- **Booking horizon** — the most calendar days ahead of today that a refill pickup date may be booked.
- **Ready days** — calendar days from booking until a fill is ready for pickup; 0 means the fill is ready the same day.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- On a Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription whose previous fill carried 30 days supply, 90 percent of that supply is 27 days.
- On a Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription, a pickup date 14 days after today may be booked; a date 15 days after today may not.
- A Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription fill booked today is ready 2 days after today; a fill of any other class booked today is ready today.
